# S19 — Project sidebar in place of tabs

Replace the project tab row with a vertical sidebar on the left: a "Needs
you" entry at the top, then one row per project (`ui.project-nav`).

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:** new views, Overview row changes (the next slice), or mouse support beyond what S11 has.

## Why

With 15 registered projects the tab row runs off the screen: the 12th tab
is cut and the rest are hidden (owner screenshot, 2026-10-19).

## Files

- `internal/tui/`, `testdata/golden/`, `docs/dashboard.md` (Layout, keys).

## Failing tests

- The sidebar lists "Needs you" first, then every project; each project row
  shows its needs-you count and the running marker `*`, and the selected
  row is marked by more than colour (reverse plus a `>`), also under
  NO_COLOR (`ui.no-color`).
- "Needs you" shows today's all-projects Overview; a project row shows
  that project's rows only. The view bar (Overview, Waves, Roadmap,
  Decisions) stays at the top of the main pane.
- Keys: `up`/`down` and `k`/`j` move the selection; `tab`/`shift+tab` and
  `1`-`9` keep working; `r` refreshes the selected project, or every
  project on "Needs you"; `/` filters projects by name, and `esc` clears it.
- Order: projects with something for the owner first, then those running,
  then the rest, registry order inside each group; the selection follows
  its project when the order changes.
- When there are more projects than rows, the list scrolls and keeps the
  selection visible, with a `+N more` hint at the cut.
- Below about 100 columns the sidebar shows short names (cut with an
  ellipsis) and badges; a key (`s`) hides and shows it at any width.
- Golden views at 80x24, 120x40 and with 15 projects.
